verdict.rationale: The API documents a customer lookup endpoint keyed on your own external identifier, which returns a 308 Permanent Redirect to the canonical customer resource. That gives developers a stable way to reconcile customer records with their own systems. Nothing in the pack shows cases carrying or being queryable by external identifiers, so the case half of the story is unevidenced. missing for 10: external identifiers on case records, documentation of how external identifiers are set and kept unique, independent or hands-on corroboration of the lookup.
